pages.title: Aspects
pages.text: $(bold)Aspects$()$(br2)All Arcane Archives items and blocks have registered Thaumcraft aspects. Notably, Radiant Quartz is a source of Praecantatio.

$(br2)$(item)Rivertear$() If you have a $(l:gems/rivertear)Rivertear$() somewhere in your inventory (or slotted in a $(l:items/gem_socket)Gem Socket$()), right clicking a Crucible will refill it with water.
pages.title: Crucible

pages.text: $(br2)$(item)Raw Quartz Cluster$() $(l:blocks/raw_quartz_cluster)Raw Quartz Clusters$() can be used as an infusion stabilizer.$(br2)$(item)Brazier of Hoarding$() $(l:blocks/brazier_hoarding)Braziers of Hoarding$() can also be used as an infusion stabilizer.
pages.title: Infusion
